baseline_configuration.description: configuration S (household demand), the baseline since rc67: residential dung read from the HIES rounds' reported cake; the rest of the diverted supply has no observed destination and is outside the total - see outputs/residential_dung_ledger_2024.csv for the fate account and outputs/national_dung_variants.csv for what each destination is worth
baseline_configuration.why: the residential row measures what households burn, and the household survey is what observes it; nothing held supports the fivefold survey under-count the ledger reading would need

gwp_basis.note: fossil and biogenic CH4 carry distinct AR5 values; see pkinv.core.gwp

inventory: Pakistan national greenhouse-gas and air-pollutant inventory, ten sectors, excluding LULUCF

licences.data_and_text: CC-BY-4.0 for project-owned primary products and text; per-file upstream terms retained
odbl_carveouts: the odbl-1.0 rows of data/facility_registry.csv and outputs/pakemis_facility_registry.csv, which ship as mixed-per-row in the deposit manifest with the per-row counts in their reason
licences.odbl_note: OpenStreetMap (c) contributors. ODbL source databases, mixed facility registries, preserved baselines and potentially affected legacy spatial products are in a separate companion. The primary geographic products are rebuilt without OSM geometry or weights. See LICENSE-data, LICENSE-ODbL and pakemis_primary_geography_licence_audit.csv; removing a source file alone does not remove derivative-database obligations.
licences.undetermined: UNEP MARS plume observations carry no licence declaration in the record. They are EVALUATION evidence only - no MARS quantity enters any emission total, factor or allocation - and are excluded from any primary data record until the rights are established.

monte_carlo.rng: Mersenne Twister (CPython random module); gauss via Box-Muller with paired-variate cache; python 3.11

national_totals.note: S (household dung as the survey observes it) is the baseline since release 1.0.0rc67; L (all the dung agriculture diverts, burned in households) is a destination assumption and the baseline of every earlier release. Under S the rest of the diverted dung has no observed destination and is outside the total: the fate account is outputs/residential_dung_ledger_2024.csv and each candidate destination is priced for every year in outputs/pakemis_dung_fate_by_year.csv. A national figure quoted without its configuration is ambiguous.

product.name: PakEmis
product.repository_note: the public development repository, without the third-party source documents, whose checksums it lists; the git block names its commit, and restricted_layers the commit of the private checkout that holds the documents. Releases through 1.0.0rc68 were made in that private repository and their commits are not in the public history

reference_reporting_period.label: FY2023-24
reference_reporting_period.note: every sector reports the same twelve months, so the national total is a single-period inventory

reference_years.convention: every sector is on one reporting period; the integer reference_year is each sector's own label for it and means different things under different conventions (fiscal-end, fiscal-start), so read reporting_period, not the year

reporting_period.label: July 2015--June 2025 (ten fiscal years)
reporting_period.note: Common supported fiscal window; source coverage is separately documented. FY2025-26 is a partial provisional extension, outside common national totals.
